text: Enjoy anticipation. The phase of hunger and incipient desire is not torment but a pleasure in its own right. Enjoy the anticipation of a date, a vacation, a delicious dinner. By stretching out this phase and savoring it, you make the subsequent satiation deeper and more vivid. Anticipation contains no less magic than the event itself. Keep in mind that this has nothing to do with the habit of postponing pleasure “for later.” Many people live by the principle “once I finish this project / lose weight / earn money—then I’ll enjoy myself.” This trap of the mind steals the real present. A spoon is precious at dinnertime. And the best one is the one in your hands :)
